stories.title: Spokane community honors two sheriff's deputies killed in the line of duty
stories.summary: Deputies Mason Acheson and Parker Perry were shot and killed Nov. 3 while responding to a domestic violence call in Spangle, Washington.

stories.title: Washington Airbnb owner accused of bear-spraying guests, threatening with replica gun
stories.summary: Investigators say Joshua Vick sprayed two guests with bear spray and threatened to shoot them with a replica gun — the second report of violence this month.

stories.title: Holiday season brings increased scam risks; Tigard workshop aims to educate residents
stories.summary: Tigard police are partnering with Chase Bank to help residents recognize holiday scams and protect their finances through a community scam prevention workshop.

stories.title: Army Corps plans gradual Detroit Lake drawdown, starting this year
stories.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers says it will gradually lower Detroit Lake to lower-than-normal levels, with plans to drop it further over next several years.

stories.title: The Grammy nominations are out. Here's where Portland fits in
stories.summary: The biggest names in music aren't the only Grammy stories worth following. Portland has a few connections of its own.

stories.title: Portland study highlights investments in PPS schools up for closure
stories.summary: A report looks into at how much public money has already been invested in infrastructure around the potential school closure sites and what might come next.

stories.title: 1 person dies after 'disturbance' in Clatsop County
stories.summary: Deputies responded to a "disturbance" and initially found a person with life-threatening injuries. They died at the scene and a suspect was taken into custody.

stories.title: Marion County kidnapping suspect arrested in Newberg SWAT raid
stories.summary: Law enforcement descended on a Newberg home to arrest Nathan Muniz, 30, on new charges. Muniz was last arrested in January for a violent road rage incident.

stories.title: Body found in water below Yaquina Head Lighthouse in Newport
stories.summary: The U.S. Coast Guard says the body of a man was found in the water below Yaquina Head Lighthouse in Newport on Monday. Oregon State Police is investigating.

stories.title: Portland could make companies with huge CEO-to-worker pay gaps pay more in city taxes
stories.summary: Portland's "Fair Share Tax" proposal could increase taxes on major corporations, raising $72 million for city services.

stories.title: Man accused of kidnapping 10-year-old Canby girl writes to KGW from jail
stories.summary: Vince Chavez claimed to KGW that he was rescuing the 10-year-old girl from a "living situation that no kid should encounter," not abducting her.

stories.title: Two deputies, K9 injured after Gilliam County pursuit ends in head-on crash
stories.summary: The Gilliam County Sheriff's Office said that a deputy put his patrol SUV directly in the path of a fleeing driver off Highway 19 and Clem Road.
